Python with function docstring, verify docstring count

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"docstrings\":true,\"language\":\"python\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("def greet(name):\n    \"\"\"Say hello to someone.\"\"\"\n    return f\"Hello {name}\"\n", config);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
